meta.title: Vriksha Architecture
meta.subtitle: SEBI RA research subscription platform: public strategy pages, Supabase access control, KYC/OCR, checkout, and package import boundary.

status_legend.built: implemented in this repo and wired to runtime routes/scripts
status_legend.partial: interface or route exists; behavior depends on configuration or an unfinished external deployment
status_legend.planned: designed or documented, not fully built in this repo

nodes.label: Visitor / Subscriber Browser
nodes.tooltip: User browses public pages, verifies email, submits KYC, builds a basket, and downloads subscriber CSVs.

nodes.label: Public Pages & Strategy Catalog
nodes.tooltip: Home, catalog, compliance, contact, and strategy detail pages render public research and disclosure content.

nodes.label: Strategy Detail + Paywall
nodes.tooltip: Shows methodology and preview data. Latest model portfolio and recent rebalances are gated by server-side access checks.

nodes.label: Performance Disclosure Gate
nodes.tooltip: Collects email OTP and acknowledgement before revealing backtest performance in the current browser session.

nodes.label: Dashboard + Access Matrix
nodes.tooltip: Reads Supabase profile, KYC, subscriptions, grants, and strategy list to show subscriber entitlements.

nodes.label: Imported Strategy JSON
nodes.tooltip: The live display source for strategy metadata, charts, holdings, rebalances, and CSV export rows. Falls back to a local sample only if empty.

nodes.label: Access Guard Library
nodes.tooltip: Checks demo access, Supabase auth cookies, active subscriptions, manual grants, and admin roles before returning protected data.

nodes.label: Subscriber CSV Export API
nodes.tooltip: Generates latest model portfolio and rebalance-history CSV responses only after hasStrategyAccess succeeds.

nodes.label: OTP Email API
nodes.tooltip: Generates Supabase magic-link OTPs and sends the one-time code through Resend instead of Supabase email templates.

nodes.label: Performance Access Log API
nodes.tooltip: Persists the acknowledgement audit trail with user, strategy slug, disclaimer version, user-agent, and IP address.

nodes.label: Contact API
nodes.tooltip: Validates enquiries, stores them in Supabase, and optionally emails the contact desk.

nodes.label: KYC Submit API
nodes.tooltip: Validates client details and PAN, hashes sensitive values, uploads documents, records consents/audit events, creates OCR jobs, and triggers the worker when configured.

nodes.label: Checkout Create API
nodes.tooltip: Built route recalculates basket pricing, enforces KYC and fee cap, creates checkout rows, and creates a Razorpay order when keys exist. The UI still warns assisted onboarding is active.

nodes.label: Razorpay Webhook API
nodes.tooltip: Verifies webhook signature, records payment audit data, and creates per-strategy active subscription rows for captured/paid events.

nodes.label: Supabase Auth + SSR Cookies
nodes.tooltip: Supabase auth is used for email OTP identity, server clients, browser clients, and middleware session refresh.

nodes.label: Supabase Postgres + RLS Tables
nodes.tooltip: Stores profiles, performance logs, contact enquiries, pricing, checkout sessions/items, payments, subscriptions, access grants, KYC profiles/documents/consents/jobs/audit events. RLS is enabled by migrations.

nodes.label: Private KYC Document Bucket
nodes.tooltip: Private kyc-documents bucket stores uploaded PAN/address files. Admin pages use short-lived signed URLs.

nodes.label: Razorpay Orders + Webhooks
nodes.tooltip: Order creation and webhook verification are implemented. Production usefulness depends on live Razorpay keys, webhook endpoint configuration, and payment ops.

nodes.label: Resend Transactional Email
nodes.tooltip: Used for OTP, contact notifications, and KYC status emails when RESEND_API_KEY and sender env vars are configured.

nodes.label: KYC OCR Worker
nodes.tooltip: Worker code exists and can run as a poller or HTTP-triggered service. Production deployment is documented but external to this repo.

nodes.label: Admin KYC Review Queue
nodes.tooltip: Admins inspect OCR output, open signed documents, verify/reject/request resubmission, rerun OCR, audit actions, and send status emails.

nodes.label: External Research / Backtest Project
nodes.tooltip: The strategy engine that creates signals, ranks, backtests, and final model portfolios is explicitly outside Vriksha. Vriksha only imports approved outputs.

nodes.label: Strategy Package Contract
nodes.tooltip: Defines required manifest/CSV/JSON/markdown files and validates required columns for full packages and model-portfolio updates.

nodes.label: Python Strategy Importer
nodes.tooltip: Validates approved packages and rewrites web/lib/imported-strategies.json for the Next.js app. It does not run strategy logic.

nodes.label: Admin Publishing Console
nodes.tooltip: Admin landing page lists publishing tasks and links to KYC queue. Import, publish, grant, and disclosure workflows are described but not implemented as full UI actions.

nodes.label: Prisma Domain Schema
nodes.tooltip: A richer typed domain model exists, but current runtime routes use Supabase JS and SQL migrations instead of Prisma client paths.

nodes.label: Vercel / Next Hosting
nodes.tooltip: The web app is designed for Vercel/Next hosting. Deployment state is environment-dependent and not proven by local code alone.

flows.name: Public Research Browse
flows.summary: Visitor opens public pages and strategy detail content from imported strategy JSON.
flows.description: Next.js server pages render public strategy catalog/detail information from web/lib/imported-strategies.json, with protected holdings/rebalances hidden unless access checks pass.

flows.name: Backtest Performance Request
flows.summary: Email OTP plus acknowledgement unlocks backtest details and logs the compliance event.
flows.description: The browser sends an OTP request, verifies through Supabase auth, stores an acknowledgement in sessionStorage, and posts a performance access log to Supabase.

flows.name: Subscriber CSV Export
flows.summary: Protected CSV routes return model portfolio/rebalance data only after server-side access checks.
flows.description: The export route checks subscription/manual grant/demo access through Supabase, reads static strategy data, and returns a generated CSV response.

flows.name: KYC Submission + OCR
flows.summary: KYC upload is built; OCR worker code exists but production deployment is external.
flows.description: Logged-in users submit KYC details and documents. The app stores profiles/documents/consents/jobs, uploads private files, and triggers or relies on the Python OCR worker to process jobs and update statuses.

flows.name: Checkout + Payment Unlock
flows.summary: Checkout and webhook routes exist; live payment operation depends on configured Razorpay environment.
flows.description: After verified KYC, checkout recalculates basket pricing and fee-cap rules, creates checkout rows, optionally creates a Razorpay order, and webhook confirmation writes payments/subscriptions that unlock access.

flows.name: Approved Strategy Package Import
flows.summary: External research outputs are validated and transformed into the JSON used by the app.
flows.description: The research/backtest project remains outside Vriksha. Approved packages are checked against the documented contract, then the Python importer parses CSV/JSON/markdown into web/lib/imported-strategies.json.

flows.name: Contact Enquiry
flows.summary: Contact form stores enquiries and optionally sends Resend email.
flows.description: The client form posts validated enquiry data to the contact API, which persists the row and updates email delivery status after a Resend attempt.

flows.name: Admin Review Surface
flows.summary: KYC review is implemented; broader publishing/grants console is mostly a task shell.
flows.description: Admin role checks protect /admin and /admin/kyc. KYC review can update decisions and audit events; other publishing tasks are listed but not yet implemented as full workflows.
